title: ci-cd deployment config
description: A file a deployment owns, named by CI_CD_DEPLOYMENT_CONFIG. ci-cd holds no release age.

release_age.description: Where the deployment keeps its release age. The value must read '<n> days'.

file.description: A JSON file, relative to this config.

key.description: A top-level key of that file.

gate_on_aged_fix.description: OSV ecosystems in which `bin/ci gate` blocks on a fix at least the age old.
